categories.label: POLICE & CRIMINAL
categories.description: Protocols for vehicle checks, detention, searches, and official notices.

scenarios.label: Stopped for Vehicle Check
scenarios.description: Routine checkpoints, document verification, and on-spot challans.

triage_questions.text: What is the officer requesting?

options.label: Document inspection or routine check
Demanding cash or threatening seizure without challan
Suspecting intoxication / breathalyzer test

scenarios.label: Arrest & Police Custody
scenarios.description: Formal detention, arrest memos, interrogation, and custodial rights.

triage_questions.text: What is the current status of detention?

options.label: Being questioned or asked to come to station
Handcuffed or formally placed under arrest
Detained overnight or over 24 hours

scenarios.label: Police at Door / Home Search
scenarios.description: Police arrival at private residence, search warrants, and female resident protections.

triage_questions.text: Do the officers present a signed search warrant?

options.label: No warrant shown, asking to enter
Warrant produced from magistrate
Female occupants inside after sunset

scenarios.label: Police Station Refusing to File FIR
scenarios.description: Remedies when station house officer declines to register a cognizable offense complaint.

triage_questions.text: Why was the FIR registration declined?

options.label: Told it is outside jurisdiction (Zero FIR applicable)
Officer advising informal compromise instead
Outright refusal without reason

scenarios.label: False Criminal Accusation / FIR
scenarios.description: Steps when named falsely in a police report or threatened with fabricated charges.

triage_questions.text: What official stage has the complaint reached?

options.label: Threat of FIR made by other party
FIR officially registered; arrest imminent
Seeking quashing of frivolous complaint

scenarios.label: Police Summons / Notice (Sec 41A / 35)
scenarios.description: Receiving formal notice to appear for inquiry or statement recording.

triage_questions.text: How was the notice delivered?

options.label: Formal written notice received with date
Informal phone call or WhatsApp message
Unable to attend on specified date

scenarios.label: Demand for Bribe by Public Servant
scenarios.description: Corrupt demands for official work, vigilance reporting, and evidence safety.

triage_questions.text: What is the public official withholding?

options.label: Withholding public document, NOC, or license
Police demanding cash to drop action
Filing formal Anti-Corruption Bureau complaint

categories.label: CAMPUS
categories.description: Protections for university students against ragging, harassment, academic penalties, and fee disputes.

scenarios.label: Victim of Campus Ragging
scenarios.description: Physical, mental, or psychological harassment by senior students.

triage_questions.text: Is there immediate physical danger or ongoing violence?

options.label: Immediate physical assault or ongoing danger
Verbal abuse, intimidation, or forced tasks
Institution failing to take action

scenarios.label: Accused of Campus Ragging
scenarios.description: Named in an inquiry or facing Anti-Ragging Committee disciplinary hearings.

triage_questions.text: Has the Anti-Ragging Committee served formal notice?

options.label: Called for committee hearing
Police FIR registered against you
Suspension order issued without fair hearing

scenarios.label: Witness to Campus Ragging
scenarios.description: Witnessing abuse, confidential reporting options, and whistleblower protections.

triage_questions.text: Do you need confidential or anonymous reporting channels?

options.label: Standard campus authority reporting
Anonymous reporting via National Helpline

scenarios.label: Sexual Harassment on Campus (ICC / POSH)
scenarios.description: Reporting to Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) and interim safety protections.

triage_questions.text: What step do you wish to initiate?

options.label: Filing initial ICC written complaint
Requesting interim relief (hostel change, attendance safeguard)
Inquiry committee bias or retaliation

scenarios.label: Exam Malpractice Allegation
scenarios.description: Booked under unfair means (UFM) or disciplinary board examination summons.

triage_questions.text: What action did the examination flying squad take?

options.label: Answer sheet taken; UFM form signed
Appearing before Malpractice Disciplinary Board

scenarios.label: Original Certificates / Degrees Withheld
scenarios.description: College illegally holding original mark sheets, transfer certificates, or diplomas.

triage_questions.text: Why is the college retaining original documents?

options.label: Claiming pending fee dues or exit fine
Bond enforcement for dropped course

scenarios.label: College Fee Refund Dispute
scenarios.description: Cancellation of admission within UGC refund notification timelines.

triage_questions.text: When was the admission withdrawal requested?

options.label: Before or within 15 days of formal admission deadline
Institution refusing UGC mandate refund

scenarios.label: Suspension or Expulsion Notice
scenarios.description: Arbitrary rustication without show-cause notice or due disciplinary process.

triage_questions.text: Were you issued a show cause notice before the order?

options.label: Show cause notice received; drafting reply
Summary suspension without hearing

scenarios.label: Scholarship or Fellowship Denied / Delayed
scenarios.description: Government or institutional scholarship fund delays and non-disbursement.

triage_questions.text: What type of scholarship is withheld?

options.label: National / State scholarship portal scheme
College failing to verify application documents

categories.label: COUPLES & PUBLIC
categories.description: Rights for consenting adult couples in hotels, parks, and against moral policing.

scenarios.label: Hotel Refusal to Adult Couple
scenarios.description: Hotels denying room check-in to consenting adult couples with valid ID.

triage_questions.text: What ground is the hotel citing for refusal?

options.label: Same city / local resident ID restriction
Demanding marriage certificate

scenarios.label: Police Questioning / Detaining Couple in Public
scenarios.description: Interrogation, moral policing, or threats of calling parents in public spaces.

triage_questions.text: What is the officer threatening?

options.label: Demanding ID and questioning presence in public park
Threatening to contact parents
Demanding spot cash or extortion

scenarios.label: Police Raid on Hotel Room
scenarios.description: Police entering private hotel rooms occupied by consenting adults.

triage_questions.text: What are the officers claiming?

options.label: Routine search / suspicious activity claim
Threatening public indecency charges

scenarios.label: Moral Policing & Vigilante Harassment
scenarios.description: Unlawful restraint, filming, or intimidation by public vigilante groups.

triage_questions.text: Is a crowd surrounding you or threatening violence?

options.label: Active crowd gathering; immediate physical danger
Individual recording video or questioning

scenarios.label: Family Filed False Missing / Kidnapping Report
scenarios.description: Adult couple facing false abduction complaints filed by non-consenting families.

triage_questions.text: Has the police station contacted you or your partner?

options.label: Police call received regarding missing person report
Protection petition needed in High Court

scenarios.label: POCSO Implications (Partner Near 18)
scenarios.description: Navigating statutory consent thresholds and mandatory legal protections.

triage_questions.text: Is either individual strictly below 18 years of age?

options.label: One partner is below 18 years
Allegations of inducement or kidnapping

scenarios.label: Inter-Faith / Inter-Caste Marriage Threat
scenarios.description: Threats to life or liberty from family members; safe house and court protection.

triage_questions.text: Are there active physical threats to life or liberty?

options.label: Immediate physical tracking and threats
Seeking police protection cell / safe home

scenarios.label: Leaked Intimate Media & Blackmail
scenarios.description: Non-consensual sharing of intimate images, extortion threats, and takedown procedures.

triage_questions.text: What action has the blackmailer taken?

options.label: Demanding money or sexual favors with threat to leak
Images already circulated online (urgent takedown)

categories.label: ONLINE & MONEY
categories.description: Remedies for cyber financial fraud, predatory loan apps, frozen accounts, and digital blackmail.

scenarios.label: UPI / Bank Transfer Fraud
scenarios.description: Unauthorized account debits, fraudulent payment links, and golden-hour freeze reporting.

triage_questions.text: When did the unauthorized transaction happen?

options.label: Within the last 2-3 hours (Golden Hour)
More than 24 hours ago

scenarios.label: Predatory Loan App Harassment
scenarios.description: Unregistered instant loan apps accessing contact lists and sending morphed photo threats.

triage_questions.text: What harassment method is the lender using?

options.label: Threatening calls and messages to your phone
Calling your family and contacts from address book
Threatening morphed photos / fake notices

scenarios.label: Bank Account Frozen by Cyber Police
scenarios.description: Savings account debit-freeze under Sec 102/106 CrPC/BNSS linked to third-party fraud trail.

triage_questions.text: What information did the bank branch provide?

options.label: Bank provided Cyber Cell notice number and state
Bank refused to give police contact details
Lien amount is smaller than total balance

scenarios.label: Identity Theft & SIM Swap
scenarios.description: PAN/Aadhaar misuse, unauthorized loan accounts, or sudden cellular signal disconnection.

triage_questions.text: What indicator of identity theft was detected?

options.label: Unknown loans appearing on CIBIL report
SIM card suddenly deactivated / SIM swap suspected

scenarios.label: Video Call Sextortion Trap
scenarios.description: WhatsApp video call recording, morphed video threats, and fake police caller extortion.

triage_questions.text: What is the extortionist doing?

options.label: Demanding immediate payment via UPI
Caller posing as Cyber Cell / CBI officer

scenarios.label: Fake Job Offer / Task Scam
scenarios.description: Telegram task scams, work-from-home prepayments, and bogus recruitment fees.

triage_questions.text: Have funds already been transferred?

options.label: Money paid; now demanding more for 'tax release'
Offer received; verifying legitimacy before paying

categories.label: WORK
categories.description: Workplace protections against withheld wages, forced exits, illegal termination, and toxic contracts.

scenarios.label: Salary / Dues Withheld by Employer
scenarios.description: Non-payment of earned wages, full-and-final settlement delays, and gratuity disputes.

triage_questions.text: How long has the compensation been delayed?

options.label: Current employee; salary delayed over 15 days
Exited employee; FnF withheld past 45 days
Company claiming business losses or ghosting

scenarios.label: Forced / Coerced Resignation
scenarios.description: Employer coercing voluntary resignation to avoid severance or notice pay.

triage_questions.text: Have you already submitted a resignation letter?

options.label: Currently being pressured; have not signed
Signed under duress / immediate retraction

scenarios.label: Unpaid Internship & Stipend Default
scenarios.description: Full-time work under the guise of an internship without promised stipend or completion certificate.

triage_questions.text: What is the primary dispute?

options.label: Stipend promised in offer letter is not paid
Internship certificate withheld after completion

scenarios.label: Workplace Sexual Harassment (POSH)
scenarios.description: Hostile work environment, unwelcome conduct, and Internal Committee complaint procedures.

triage_questions.text: What step do you wish to initiate?

options.label: Submitting formal complaint to Internal Committee (IC)
Seeking interim relief during pendency

scenarios.label: Employment Contract Review Before Signing
scenarios.description: Checking for illegal non-compete clauses, exorbitant exit bond penalties, and notice locks.

triage_questions.text: Which clause is concerning in the offer?

options.label: Financial bond / penalty for leaving within 1-2 years
Post-employment non-compete restriction

scenarios.label: Sudden Termination Without Notice
scenarios.description: Immediate firing without cause, severance, or contractual notice period pay.

triage_questions.text: What reason was given for termination?

options.label: Termination without reason or notice pay
Termination citing false misconduct allegations

categories.label: HOUSING
categories.description: Tenant protections against unlawful eviction, deposit deductions, PG curfew fines, and moral scrutiny.

scenarios.label: Illegal Eviction / Lockout
scenarios.description: Landlord changing locks, cutting electricity/water, or threatening immediate removal.

triage_questions.text: What illegal measure has the landlord taken?

options.label: Threatening to remove belongings without court order
Cut electricity, water, or changed door locks

scenarios.label: Rental Security Deposit Not Returned
scenarios.description: Arbitrary deductions for normal wear-and-tear or refusal to refund deposit upon move-out.

triage_questions.text: Have you vacated the premises and handed over keys?

options.label: Premises vacated; landlord delaying refund
Arbitrary painting/cleaning deductions claimed

scenarios.label: Hostel / PG Rule & Deposit Disputes
scenarios.description: Discriminatory curfew fines, sudden rent hikes, and non-refundable PG deposits.

triage_questions.text: What is the nature of the PG dispute?

options.label: Notice given but deposit refund refused
Exorbitant arbitrary fines or early curfew penalties

scenarios.label: Landlord Objections to Guests / Couples
scenarios.description: Moral policing by landlords, society RWAs, or restriction on adult visitors.

triage_questions.text: Who is restricting your guests?

options.label: Landlord objecting to opposite-gender guest
RWA / Society security stopping entry

categories.label: FAMILY & SAFETY
categories.description: Emergency remedies for domestic abuse, stalking, child safety, and forced marriage pressure.

scenarios.label: Domestic Violence (DV Act Emergency)
scenarios.description: Physical, emotional, or economic abuse within domestic relationships; protection orders.

triage_questions.text: Is there ongoing physical assault or imminent bodily harm?

options.label: Immediate physical danger / medical emergency
Seeking protection order or residence order
Facing eviction from shared matrimonial household

scenarios.label: Physical or Online Stalking
scenarios.description: Repeated following, unwanted communication, or digital surveillance by an individual.

triage_questions.text: How is the stalking occurring?

options.label: Digital stalking (messages, social media tracking)
Physical following / waiting near residence or college

scenarios.label: Child in Danger / POCSO
scenarios.description: Protection of minors from abuse, exploitation, or hazardous environments (Childline 1098).

triage_questions.text: What is the urgent concern?

options.label: Child in immediate physical danger or abuse
Child labor or exploitation reporting

scenarios.label: Forced Marriage Pressure on Adult
scenarios.description: Confinement, threats, or coercion to enter into marriage against adult consent.

triage_questions.text: Are you being physically confined or your documents confiscated?

options.label: Physical confinement / passport or ID seized
Intense emotional and social pressure

categories.label: CONSUMER & DOCUMENTS
categories.description: Rights under Consumer Protection Act, warranty defaults, contract signing, and legal notices.

scenarios.label: Consumer Refund / Service Denied
scenarios.description: Unfair trade practices, 'no refund' arbitrary policies, and consumer helpline complaints.

triage_questions.text: What did the seller/service provider state?

options.label: Citing 'no refund under any condition' policy
Paid service not delivered or cancelled by company

scenarios.label: Defective Product & Warranty Refusal
scenarios.description: Authorized service center refusing warranty coverage or selling hazardous goods.

triage_questions.text: Is the product within the stated warranty period?

options.label: Within warranty; claim rejected arbitrarily
Product caused physical or property damage

scenarios.label: What to Check Before Signing Any Document
scenarios.description: Essential safeguards before signing police memos, arbitration waivers, or indemnities.

triage_questions.text: What type of document are you being asked to sign?

options.label: Blank paper, settlement, or police statement
Commercial agreement, waiver, or bond

scenarios.label: Received Legal Notice
scenarios.description: Steps when served with an advocate's notice; response timelines and lawyer consultation.

triage_questions.text: What matter is addressed in the legal notice?

options.label: Demand for money, cheque bounce (Sec 138), or debt
Defamation, trademark, or employment breach claim
